_readme: Arabic copy for the landing page. Keys are the exact English strings as they
appear in index.html; scripts/build-ar.py matches whole text nodes and the
attributes listed in that script, then writes ar/index.html.
`keep` is the deliberate do-not-translate list: brand names, people, firms,
codes and API literals. Anything that is in neither map is reported by the
build as untranslated, so new English copy cannot ship silently in English.
Terminology follows the product, not this page: web/lib/i18n/catalogs/*.ts
already settled on الملفات for matters, القضايا for cases, أموال العميل for
client funds. A visitor who reads the page in Arabic and then signs in should
not have to learn a second vocabulary.
